nodes.name: event_loop.rs
nodes.summary: Abstracts the event loop into winit-backed (headed) and condvar-based (headless) variants, providing a unified interface for application lifecycle and loop wake.

nodes.name: gamepad.rs
nodes.summary: Gamepad input handling using Gilrs to poll controllers, emit gamepad events to webviews, and manage haptic feedback effects with scheduling and cancellation.

nodes.name: geometry.rs
nodes.summary: Thin conversion helpers translating between winit window coordinate types and Servo euclid geometry types (Size2D, Point2D).

nodes.name: gui.rs
nodes.summary: Main egui-based browser chrome implementation with toolbar, tabs, URL bar, back/forward navigation, status bar, favicon loading, and accessibility integration.

nodes.name: headed_window.rs
nodes.summary: Full winit window implementation managing keyboard, mouse, and touch input; embedder controls; XR rendering; cursor handling; and screen geometry for headed mode.

nodes.name: headless_window.rs
nodes.summary: Minimal offscreen window implementation for headless mode, providing window metrics, rendering context, and basic lifecycle without a visible surface.
